Code owners of `smartthings` can trigger bot actions by commenting:

- `@home-assistant close` Closes the pull request.
- `@home-assistant rename Awesome new title` Renames the pull request.
- `@home-assistant reopen` Reopen the pull request.

Thanks for your work on this! Based on how the code is written, it will only map components into switches and sensors (incl. binary). We should assume that a component can be mapped into _any_ entity type.

I also see you take into account `disabledComponents` (see comment in the lib PR), but we also have to consider `disabledCapabilities` when working with components. I'm unsure of the permanence of these values at runtime, but think we should exclude them from subscriptions at startup.

This PR is also pending a library update.

Because there hasn't been any activity on this PR for quite some time now, I've decided to close it for being stale.

Feel free to re-open this PR when you are ready to pick up work on it again 👍

review_comments:
I think status data for main is only on the primary status object, not nested in the component status objects, therefore we need to branch every time we try to fetch the current status.

Alternately, we could modify the base library further to refactor how the main component stores it's statuses, but that is a breaking change.
This code should be updated to exclude disabled components and capabilities.
